description: Real LLM benchmark tasks derived from real GitHub issues and merged PRs. Agents receive issue-level requirements, work from the pre-PR commit, and are verified through hidden behavior contracts plus real project regression tests.

tasks.title: Got issue #2435: uploadProgress should be granular for json and form options
tasks.prompt: Implement the real Got issue #2435. The issue reports that `uploadProgress` only emits 0% and 100% when callers use the `json` or `form` options, because Got serializes those payloads into a single string before writing. Users expect granular upload progress for `json` and `form` just like they can get when they manually serialize and chunk a `body`. Update Got so large non-stream request bodies created from `body`, `json`, and `form` are written in chunks and emit intermediate uploadProgress events. Preserve upload completion semantics, beforeRequest hook short-circuit behavior, and redirect behavior for buffered request bodies, especially early 307 redirects that replay the request body. Because runtime source imports the chunking helper, move `chunk-data` from devDependencies to dependencies. Update documentation and focused in-project tests for progress, hooks, and redirects. Keep the implementation scoped to source/core/index.ts, test/progress.ts, test/hooks.ts, test/redirects.ts, documentation/3-streams.md, and package.json only. Do not modify unrelated source files, examples, lockfiles, generated dist output, or README. Run the verifier before finishing, using the verifier command exactly as provided.

anti_shortcut_rules: Do not modify unrelated source files, examples, README, lockfiles, or generated dist output for this task.
Implement runtime behavior in source/core/index.ts, not only in tests or docs.
Large json, form, Buffer, and typed array bodies must emit intermediate uploadProgress events, not only 0% and 100%.
Preserve final upload-complete behavior and do not emit stale progress after request cancellation or stale redirected writes.
Early 307 redirects with buffered bodies must replay the body and preserve upload progress totals.
beforeRequest hooks that return a response must still short-circuit large json/body/typed-array requests.
Move chunk-data to dependencies because runtime source imports it.

Add verifier-visible tests named `upload progress - json option`, `upload progress - form option`, `upload progress - buffer body`, `returning HTTP response from a beforeRequest hook with large json body`, `early 307 redirect preserves upload progress totals`, and `early 307 redirect finalizes writable side for buffered body`.
Update documentation/3-streams.md to say granular upload progress is supported for non-stream body, json, and form options.
Do not claim success until the provided verifier passes.
